note: Vincent's order at Jack Rabbit Slim's, bloody as hell

dish.make_ahead: Season the steaks an hour ahead

steps.text: Season the sirloin steaks with salt an hour ahead and leave them out of the fridge.
Bake the frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Heat the oil in a pan until smoking and sear the steaks for 2 minutes a side until 48C inside, then rest them for 5 minutes.
In the same pan cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the brandy and cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream. Serve with the steaks, fries and peppercorn sauce.

note: with pineapple, like Brett's breakfast

dish.make_ahead: Teriyaki glaze up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Grill the pineapple rings until charred.
Shape the mince into 4 thick patties.
Grill the patties, brushing with the teriyaki, then melt the cheddar on top.
Toast the buns and build with lettuce, patty and pineapple.

note: Beef, onion and green pepper in tangy tomato sauce on toasted buns

steps.text: Dice the onion and capsicum.
Brown the mince with the onion and capsicum.
Add the tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce, sugar and mustard and simmer until thick.
Toast the buns and pile the mince on.

note: Venison steaks with a blueberry sauce and rosemary roast potatoes

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chunks. Bring the steaks to room temperature, then oil and season.
Parboil the potatoes.
Toss with oil, rosemary and salt and roast at 220C.
Sear the venison in a very hot pan for rare, then rest.
Add the stock, balsamic, blueberries, sugar and thyme to the pan and simmer until syrupy, then whisk in the butter.
Slice the venison and spoon over the sauce.

note: Seared scotch fillet with hash browns, grilled tomato and a fried egg

steps.text: Bake the hash browns at 220C until crisp.
Halve the tomatoes and grill until soft.
Season the steaks and sear in a hot pan for 3 to 4 minutes a side, then rest.
Fry the eggs sunny side up in the butter and place one on each steak.

note: Whole roast chicken glazed with honey on a bed of carrots

steps.text: Rub the whole chicken with oil, salt, crushed garlic and thyme and stuff with a halved lemon.
Roast at 200C on a bed of the carrots for 60 minutes, then brush with the honey and roast 15 minutes more until sticky.
Rest 10 minutes and carve.

note: Mustard rosemary roast beef, roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and gravy

dish.n: Frost family roast beef and Yorkshires

steps.text: Rub the beef with the mustard, rosemary and salt. Parboil the potatoes and toss in oil.
Roast the beef at 200C for medium rare, with the potatoes and honey-tossed carrots on another tray.
Rest the beef and turn the oven to 220C. Whisk the eggs, flour and milk into a batter.
Heat a little oil in each hole of a muffin tin, pour in the batter and bake without opening the oven.
Make gravy from the juices with a spoon of the flour and the stock.

note: Lamb shoulder with garlic and oregano, slow-baked in paper over potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Rest 15 minutes, open at the table

steps.text: Rub the lamb with the garlic, oregano, lemon juice and oil.
Sit on the potatoes and wrap tightly in baking paper, then foil.
Roast at 160C until it falls apart.
Rest, then open at the table so the steam rises.

note: Creamy chicken, leek and bacon filling under a pastry lid

dish.n: Gloucester chicken, leek and bacon pie
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake the pastry fresh

steps.text: Dice the bacon, chicken, leeks and carrots.
Fry the bacon, then add the chicken and brown.
Add the leeks and carrots and cook.
Stir in the flour.
Add the stock, cream and thyme and simmer.
Pour into a pie dish, top with the pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Toss the peas in butter and serve alongside.

note: Crackling pork shoulder with roast potatoes and apple sauce

dish.n: Far Far Away royal roast pork
dish.make_ahead: Roast can be cooked 2 hours ahead and rested

steps.text: Heat the oven to 230C. Score the pork skin and rub well with the salt.
Roast the pork at 230C to start the crackling.
Drop the oven to 170C and keep roasting.
Toss the potatoes in oil, add to the tray and roast with the pork.
Rest the pork under foil, then carve and serve with the potatoes and apple sauce.

note: Buttermilk brined chicken pieces, double dredged and fried crisp

steps.text: Brine the chicken overnight in the buttermilk and hot sauce
Season the flour with salt and paprika and dredge the chicken twice
Heat the oil to 165C
Fry in batches until 74C inside
Pile high on a platter

note: Triple-decker toasted club with turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo

steps.text: Grill the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread.
Layer turkey, bacon, lettuce, sliced tomato and mayo across three slices for each sandwich.
Pin with toothpicks, cut into triangles and serve with potato chips.

note: Chicken thigh green curry with Thai eggplant in coconut milk

steps.text: Fry the curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk until it splits.
Add the chicken, the rest of the coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar and eggplant. Simmer.
Cook the rice by the absorption method.
Stir through the Thai basil and serve over rice.

note: Chicken thigh and leek pie in a creamy thyme sauce

dish.n: Croquet lawn chicken and leek pie

ingredients.item: sheet puff pastry (or 2 for a deeper lid)

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil in batches, then set aside. Slice the leeks.
Soften the leeks in the same pan.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream and thyme. Return the chicken and simmer until thick.
Pour into a pie dish and top with the pastry, pressing the edges down.
Bake at 200C until puffed and deep golden.

note: Wok-fried rump steak with onion and peppers in black pepper oyster sauce

steps.text: Slice the steak thinly and slice the onion, capsicum and garlic.
Marinate the steak in soy and cornflour.
Cook the rice.
Stir-fry the beef hard in a very hot wok.
Add the onion, capsicum and garlic.
Finish with oyster sauce and cracked black pepper and serve over the rice.

note: Shredded chicken rolled in tortillas under a red chilli sauce

steps.text: Toast the chillies in a dry pan, soak in hot water, then blend with the tomatoes.
Simmer the chicken in the sauce, then shred it.
Roll the chicken in tortillas and place in a dish.
Cover with more sauce and grated cheddar.
Bake at 190C.
Serve with sour cream.

note: Fish, shrimp and mussel stew in fennel tomato broth, with garlic toast

dish.n: San Francisco cioppino with garlic toast
dish.make_ahead: Base up to 2 days, add seafood fresh

steps.text: Soften the fennel, onion and sliced garlic in the oil with the chilli.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer.
Add the fish, prawns and mussels, cover and cook until the mussels open. Stir through the parsley.
Toast the sourdough, rub with the cut garlic clove and serve alongside.

note: Lemon and garlic rubbed chicken thighs roasted over small potatoes

dish.n: Family dinner lemon and rosemary chicken

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the potatoes in oil and salt on a large tray.
Rub the chicken with lemon zest, garlic, rosemary, oil and salt and sit it skin side up on the potatoes.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear. Squeeze over the lemon juice.
Boil the beans for 3 minutes and toss with butter.

note: Thin sliced beef, tofu and vegetables swished in kombu broth, dipped in ponzu

steps.text: Soak the kombu in the water.
Slice the vegetables and tofu and arrange on platters with the beef.
Cook the rice.
Bring the broth to a simmer at the table. Swish the beef, tofu and vegetables through the broth and dip in ponzu.

film: Once Upon a Time in Mexico (2003)
note: Pork shoulder marinated in achiote and citrus, wrapped in banana leaves, roasted 4 hours

dish.make_ahead: Cooks well a day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Mix the achiote with orange and lime juice, garlic, cumin and oregano and coat the pork.
Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Wrap the pork in banana leaves and then foil.
Roast at 160C until it falls apart.
Slice the red onion and quick pickle it in lime juice and salt while the pork rests.
Shred the pork and serve with the pickled onion and warm tortillas.

note: Corn tortillas rolled around cheddar and onion under a chili gravy

steps.text: Cook the flour in oil, then stir in the chilli powder and cumin.
Add the stock gradually and simmer until thick.
Roll the tortillas around cheese and diced onion and lay in a dish.
Pour over the gravy and scatter with more cheese.
Bake at 190C until bubbling.

note: Rib roast salted overnight with garlic and rosemary, roast potatoes, horseradish

steps.text: Season the beef with salt, garlic and rosemary overnight
Roast at 220C
Lower to 160C and roast until 52C inside, adding the potatoes
Rest
Carve at the candlelit table with horseradish

note: Lamb chops, carrot and potato stew with rosemary

steps.text: Chop the onions, carrots and potatoes into chunks.
Brown the lamb in a heavy pot in batches.
Add the vegetables, stock and rosemary, cover and cook over coals or at 160C until the lamb is tender.
Finish with chopped parsley.

note: Butterflied prawns grilled in garlic chili butter, with cos and cucumber salad

steps.text: Butterfly the prawns through the shell and devein.
Melt the butter with the garlic, chilli, zest of one lemon and parsley.
Brush the prawns with the butter and grill for 2 minutes a side.
Toss the cos and cucumber with lemon juice and oil. Serve with the prawns and crusty bread for the butter.

note: Smoky chipotle lime chicken thighs in warm tortillas

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the chipotle in adobo, the crushed garlic cloves, the juice of the lime, the cumin and the oil.
Marinate the chicken thigh fillets for 30 minutes.
Slice the red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill the chicken on a hot barbecue for 5 minutes a side and slice.
Mash the avocados with lime and salt.
Warm the small tortillas and fill with avocado, chicken, onion and coriander.

note: Chicken thighs braised with mushrooms, tomato and white wine, crusty bread

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil in batches and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the same pan.
Add the mushrooms, wine and tomatoes.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the bread.

note: Beef fillet wrapped in mushrooms, prosciutto and pastry

dish.make_ahead: Wrap up to 1 day ahead, brush with egg and bake when needed

steps.text: Sear the beef all over in a hot pan.
Brush with Dijon and cool.
Chop the mushrooms and cook until completely dry.
Cool the mushrooms.
Lay prosciutto on plastic wrap, spread with the mushrooms and roll around the beef.
Chill the roll.
Wrap in puff pastry and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 200C.
Rest before slicing.

note: Linguine with crab, garlic, chili and lemon, topped with toasted breadcrumbs

ingredients.item: extra virgin olive oil, plus a little extra

steps.text: Cook the linguine in well salted water.
Toast the breadcrumbs in a little oil until golden. Set aside.
Gently fry the garlic and chilli in the oil for 2 minutes.
Add the crab, lemon zest and juice and a ladle of pasta water and warm through.
Toss with the drained pasta and parsley, then scatter with the crumbs.

note: Rare roast beef, rocket, pickled onion and horseradish cream in a baguette

steps.text: Slice the red onion thin and soak in the red wine vinegar with the sugar for 20 minutes.
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and salt.
Split the baguettes lengthways, spread with the horseradish cream and layer with the sliced rare roast beef, a handful of rocket, the drained onion and the fried shallots.
Press down and cut each into pieces.

note: Penne with chicken, garlic, sun-dried tomato, spinach and cream sauce

steps.text: Cook the penne and drain.
Sear the chicken in the oil until golden.
Add the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes, then the cream, and simmer.
Wilt in the spinach and toss through the penne with parmesan.

note: Maple Dijon roast chicken with potatoes, honey carrots and gravy

steps.text: Rub the chicken with the butter, salt and thyme leaves.
Roast at 200C, brushing with the maple syrup mixed with Dijon for the last part.
Toss the potatoes in oil and roast alongside, adding the carrots tossed in honey part way through.
Rest the chicken.
Whisk the flour into the pan juices with the stock for gravy.

note: the precinct lunch

steps.text: Season the beef.
Roast at 200C until 52C at the centre.
Rest the beef.
Simmer the stock with crushed garlic and oregano into a jus.
Shave the beef very thin.
Warm the beef gently in the jus.
Pile into the rolls, dip briefly in the jus and top with giardiniera.

note: Roast chicken with tarragon butter under the skin, creamy potato gratin

dish.make_ahead: Gratin can be made 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin and layer in a dish with the cream, garlic and salt.
Mash the butter with chopped tarragon and push under the chicken skin.
Roast the chicken at 220C, then at 180C, with the gratin on the lower shelf until tender and golden.
Rest the chicken.
Add the wine and Dijon to the tray, scrape and reduce by half.
Steam the beans and serve.

note: Crispy fried chicken thigh in a sweet, spicy soy and dried chili sauce

steps.text: Dice the chicken and toss in the potato starch.
Start the rice and cook until fluffy.
Fry the chicken in 180C oil in batches, drain, then fry a second time until crisp.
Fry the chillies, crushed garlic and grated ginger in a hot wok, then add soy, vinegar, sugar and stock.
Toss the chicken through the sauce and serve over rice.

note: the architect's dinner

steps.text: Cook the onions in butter over low heat until soft and golden.
Sear the steak hard, turning once, then rest and slice thin.
Mix the mayonnaise with the horseradish.
Toast the sourdough, spread with mayo, pile on steak and onions, top with Swiss and grill until melted.

note: Chicken thighs with saffron, ginger, green olives and preserved lemon

steps.text: Slice the onion, grate the ginger and chop the preserved lemon.
Brown the chicken in the oil.
Soften the onion with the ginger and saffron.
Add the water, preserved lemon and olives, cover and simmer until tender.
Cover the couscous with the boiling water until fluffy, then fork through.
Serve the tagine over the couscous.

note: Crumbed pork schnitzel with warm potato salad and cranberry jam

steps.text: Boil the waxy potatoes 20 minutes and slice.
Fry the diced bacon, add the white wine vinegar, the mustard, the stock and the oil and toss through the warm potatoes with chives.
Pound the pork steaks to 5mm.
Coat in flour, the beaten eggs and the breadcrumbs.
Fry in the butter and the oil for 3 minutes a side, shaking the pan so the crumb puffs.
Serve with lemon and cranberry jam.

note: Chicken enchiladas in a dried chile sauce, topped with cheese

dish.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Soak the chillies, blitz with the garlic and stock and simmer into a sauce.
Poach and shred the chicken.
Dip the tortillas in sauce, roll with chicken and some cheese, then cover with sauce and the rest of the cheese.
Bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream and onion.

note: Panko crumbed chicken schnitzel with lemon, oven fries and green salad

steps.text: Halve the chicken breasts into thin fillets.
Dip in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Bake the chips as the packet says.
Shallow fry the schnitzels until golden on each side.
Serve with lemon wedges, chips and a green salad.

note: Double beef patties, bacon and special sauce, with oven fries

dish.n: Swap your boss double bacon cheeseburgers

ingredients.item: chopped dill pickles, plus slices to serve

steps.text: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp.
Grill the bacon until crisp.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, mustard and chopped pickles into a sauce.
Roll the mince into balls and smash each flat onto a very hot greased pan. Season and cook, flip, top with cheese and cook briefly.
Stack two patties in each toasted bun with bacon, pickles, onion and sauce.

note: Chicken broth with shiitake, soft boiled eggs and egg noodles

steps.text: Simmer the chicken stock with the sliced shiitake for 10 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.
Cook the egg noodles and divide into bowls, add the halved bok choy blanched in the broth, ladle over the stock and top with halved eggs and sliced spring onion.

note: Crispy chorizo and potato in corn tortillas with avocado and pickled onion

steps.text: Fry the chorizo, potatoes, onion and chilli until crisp and golden.
Quickly pickle the extra onion in lime juice.
Warm the tortillas.
Spoon the filling into the tortillas with avocado, pickled onion and coriander.

note: Cast iron seared sirloin basted in garlic thyme butter, with roast potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Salt the steaks the night before

steps.text: Dry-brine the steaks with salt, uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Cut the potatoes into chunks, toss in oil and roast at 220C until crisp.
Season the steaks with cracked pepper. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute.
Add the butter, garlic and thyme and baste until the steaks reach 54C inside.
Rest the steaks before serving with the potatoes.

note: Snapper roasted with lemon, garlic and capers, herb buttered new potatoes

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and toss with the butter, parsley and dill.
Lay the snapper in a dish with lemon slices, sliced garlic, capers and some of the oil.
Roast at 200C until the fish flakes.
Whisk the Dijon, vinegar and remaining oil and toss through the leaves.
Serve the fish with the potatoes and salad.

film: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug (2013)
note: Pork belly with a fennel salt rub, brushed with honey, slow roasted

dish.make_ahead: Salt the pork the night before

steps.text: Score the pork skin and rub with salt and fennel seeds.
Leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Roast at 160C, brushing the meat side with honey.
Add the apple halves and roast for the last part of the cooking.
Blast at 240C until the crackling is golden.
Rest before carving.

note: Creamy bright green soup with leek, potato and watercress

steps.text: Sweat the leeks and potatoes in the butter
Add the stock and simmer
Stir in the watercress for a minute
Blitz until bright green
Finish with the cream

note: Tess in Katharine's clothes

steps.text: Sear the steaks hard in a hot pan, then rest.
Toss the cos with the tomatoes and onion.
Whisk the vinegar, oil and Dijon.
Slice the steak thin and arrange over the salad with dressing and blue cheese.

note: Smashed double cheeseburgers with pickles and onion, crinkle-cut fries

steps.text: Roll the mince into 8 balls.
Fry the potatoes once at a low heat, then again until crisp.
Smash the balls thin on a smoking griddle, flip and top with cheese.
Toast the buns.
Stack two patties per bun with pickles, onion, sauce and mustard.

note: Fried franks in pizza bread with fried potatoes, peppers and mustard

steps.text: Dice the potatoes and slice the capsicums and onions.
Fry the potatoes in oil until golden, then add the capsicums and onions and cook until soft.
Fry the franks until blistered.
Split the pizza bread rounds, fill with franks and the potato and pepper mix and finish with mustard.

note: Honey hoisin glazed roast pork neck with egg fried rice

dish.n: Mirror room char siu with fried rice

steps.text: Mix the hoisin, soy, honey, five spice and Shaoxing and coat the pork.
Marinate overnight.
Roast at 200C, glazing twice.
Rest the pork.
Fry the rice with the eggs and spring onion.
Slice the pork over the rice.

film: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2 (2011)
note: Lamb shoulder stewed with onions, carrots and stout, over buttery mash

dish.n: Lamb and stout stew over mash
dish.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Chop the onions and carrots.
Brown the lamb in batches.
Add the onions, carrots, stout and water.
Simmer until tender.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and milk.
Serve over the mash with crusty bread on the side.

note: Leg of lamb with lemon, garlic and oregano, tomato and cucumber salad

steps.text: Rub the lamb with lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano, oil and salt.
Roast at 180C.
Rest the lamb.
Chop the tomatoes and cucumber and toss with feta, oil and lemon.
Slice the lamb and serve with the salad.

note: Snapper marinated in coconut, lime and chilli, grilled in banana leaf

steps.text: Marinate the snapper in some of the coconut milk with lime juice and chilli.
Soften the banana leaves over a flame or in hot water.
Wrap each fillet in a leaf.
Grill the parcels.
Cook the rice in the remaining coconut milk with the water and salt.
Serve the fish in its leaf.

note: for a city that won't let you leave

steps.text: Split the rolls and spread with mayonnaise and mustard.
Fill with turkey, Swiss, lettuce and tomato and season.
Wrap each tightly in paper and cut in half.

note: Grilled lime and orange marinated skirt steak in double corn tortillas, salsa verde

steps.text: Juice the limes and orange, mix with the crushed garlic and cumin and marinate the steak.
Leave to marinate.
Grill very hot on both sides.
Rest the steak, then chop.
Dice the onion and warm the tortillas.
Serve in doubled tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa verde.

note: Roast pork belly glazed with soy, honey and ginger, rice and greens

steps.text: Roast the pork belly at 150C
Simmer the soy, honey, sugar and ginger until syrupy
Slice the pork and brush with glaze
Grill until sticky
Steam the rice and cook the greens

note: Topside roast with roast potatoes and pumpkin, peas and pan gravy

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Season the beef and roast until 52C in the middle.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes and pumpkin in oil.
Cook the peas.
Stir the flour into the roasting tin, add the stock and simmer into gravy.

note: Thin crust pizza with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, cut into squares

steps.text: Heat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.
Stretch the dough into two thin bases.
Top with sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms.
Bake until the crust blisters. Cut into squares.

note: Clam chowder with bacon, potato and cream in a toasted sourdough bowl

steps.text: Dice the bacon, onion, celery and potatoes.
Fry the bacon, then add the onion and celery.
Add the potatoes and water and simmer.
Add the clams, cover until they open, then stir in the cream and thyme.
Hollow and toast the sourdough rounds, then ladle in the chowder.

note: Roast beef rib with horseradish sour cream and baked potatoes

steps.text: Season the beef and leave in the fridge overnight.
Roast at 220C to start, then lower to 160C until 52C inside.
Rest the beef. Bake the potatoes alongside.
Mix the horseradish into the sour cream.
Carve thick and serve with the potatoes, sour cream and chives.

note: Crispy chicken in lemon sauce, egg fried rice and garlic broccoli

dish.n: And then? Lemon chicken and fried rice

steps.text: Cook the jasmine rice the day before and chill.
Cut the chicken thigh into strips, dip in the beaten egg, then toss in the cornflour.
Shallow fry at 180C for 5 minutes until crisp.
Simmer the juice of the lemons, the caster sugar, the water and the cornflour until glossy, and pour over.
Fry the cold rice in a hot wok with the scrambled eggs, the peas, the soy and the spring onions.
Stir-fry the head broccoli with the garlic cloves for 3 minutes.

note: Chicken thighs in garam masala tomato cream sauce, with basmati rice and naan

steps.text: Soften the onion with ginger and garlic.
Add the garam masala and tomatoes.
Add the chicken and simmer.
Cook the basmati.
Stir in the cream and kasoori methi.
Warm the naan.

note: Lime and orange marinated skirt steak with warm tortillas and salsa

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Marinate the skirt steak for 2 hours in the juice of the limes and the orange, the crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt.
Grill hot for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thin across the grain.
Serve with the warm flour tortillas and the salsa.

note: Spiced ground beef in hard shells with cheddar, lettuce, tomato and sour cream

steps.text: Brown the mince hard with the diced onion and garlic.
Stir in cumin, paprika and tomato paste, then loosen with stock and simmer.
Warm the taco shells and prepare grated cheddar, lettuce and tomato.
Spoon into shells with toppings and sour cream.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest (2006)
note: Potatoes, corn, shrimp and mussels boiled with paprika, garlic and lemon, garlic butter

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 2 in the water and 2 crushed for the butter

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water with the paprika, garlic and lemon.
Add the corn and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the prawns and mussels for 4 minutes until the mussels open.
Drain, tip onto paper and pour over melted butter mixed with the crushed garlic.

note: Chicken, mushrooms and capsicum in cream sauce, in puff pastry cases

dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Cut the pastry into squares, shape into cases and bake at 200C until puffed.
Fry the chicken in the butter, then add the mushrooms and capsicum.
Stir in the flour, then the cream and stock, and simmer until thick.
Spoon into the pastry cases.

film: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005)
note: Flathead fried in butter, parsley butter potatoes, buttered peas

steps.text: Peel and cut the potatoes, chop the parsley and pat the fish dry.
Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and toss with some of the butter and the parsley.
Pan-fry the fish in butter until golden on both sides.
Cook the peas, then toss with butter and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve everything together.

note: Seared tuna, avocado, edamame and cucumber over rice, wasabi soy

dish.n: Lion versus tuna sesame tuna bowls

steps.text: Cook the sushi rice and season with the rice vinegar and the sugar.
Coat the tuna steaks in the mixed sesame seeds.
Sear in a very hot oiled pan 45 seconds a side and slice.
Whisk the soy, the rice vinegar, the sesame oil and a little wasabi.
Boil the frozen edamame 3 minutes.
Build bowls with rice, tuna, sliced avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger and spoon over the dressing.

note: Crisp rice-flour squid with chili and scallion, jasmine rice fried with egg

dish.n: Sichuan pepper squid and egg fried rice

steps.text: Score the squid and cut into pieces.
Toss in rice flour, Sichuan pepper and salt.
Fry at 190C for a minute, then toss with chilli and spring onion.
Scramble the eggs, fry the rice with the eggs and spring onion.
Serve together.
